probable_routes.owner: Essays Project owner plus editor-adoption owner

required_inputs: the accepted baseline's excluded-capabilities and lockfile obligation
missing_inputs: Owner interpretation of whether the accepted constraint governs exposed product surface or literal transitive package names
probable_routes.mutation_risk: none for the decision; medium if the answer requires a new editor substrate
probable_routes.expected_receipt: One decision-gate result selecting retain-with-declared-residue, challenge-and-rebaseline, or stop adoption
probable_routes.fallback: Preserve the local candidate and make no full CAV2-D65 ConstructionBinding or adoption claim

follow_up: Only when full ConstructionBinding or editor adoption is requested, ask the Essays Project owner to interpret the inactive transitive table-library residue before any promotion or new baseline.
claim_ceiling: One probable next owner route only; no decision, dispatch, mutation of owner targets, complete ConstructionBinding, adoption, publication, release, or deployment.
